publisher: Water Supplies Department, Government of the Hong Kong SAR
title: Water & Sewage Tariff
archive_note: Text of the page with all sections expanded. The rates and both official calculation examples are machine-readable in the source.
establishes: The complete domestic fresh water tariff: 12 m3 free, then 4.16, 6.45, 9.05 per m3 per four-month period, unchanged since 16 February 1995
The domestic sewage charge: 2.92 per m3 with the same 12 m3 exemption, from 1 April 2017
The statutory four-month period of 121.64 days under the Waterworks Regulations (Cap. 102A), and pro-rata adjustment of tier volumes to the actual reading interval

The absence of any standing or meter charge: the page enumerates everything a domestic bill can carry, and the only additions are sewage charges, odd cents carried between bills, and a 5% surcharge on overdue bills
The billing formula, from two published worked examples: prorated tier volume rounded to three decimals, then the line amount truncated to cents
does_not_establish: That no tax applies. Hong Kong levies no general consumption tax and no tax line appears in the enumeration, but that is a fact about Hong Kong law rather than about this page.
